description: Defines data structures and counters for RRC (Radio Resource Control) metrics, including connection counters with causes, resume counters, and overall RRC metrics, following 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: rrc_connection_counter_with_cause
classes.description: Tracks RRC connection attempts and successes indexed by establishment cause.

classes.name: rrc_connection_resume_counter_with_cause
classes.description: Tracks RRC connection resume attempts and successes indexed by resume cause.

classes.name: rrc_du_metrics
classes.description: Aggregates various RRC connection and resume metrics, including counts and counters with causes.

methods.name: increase
methods.description: Increments the counter for a given cause (establishment or resume).

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of cause categories (fixed at 11).

methods.name: get_count
methods.description: Retrieves the count for a specific cause or index.

methods.name: get_cause
methods.description: Returns the cause enum value for a given index.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of counters.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns const iterator to the beginning of counters.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of counters.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns const iterator to the end of counters.
